I replied to Tobias in the thread in #central-random. I said I'd noted the corrected seat count (84 seats for the 2026 Marrow Agrisupply renewal) and won't change anything. I also suggested they correct their earlier post in #central-team, since people there may go by the wrong number.

I didn't read #central-team or check the number against any files, because Tobias said no action was needed. A seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so repeating it in the channel where Tobias posted it is fine.
